question: Under what temporal condition is the claim made that old age and death are destroyed?
premises: Practice is carried out for one year.
When that practice has been done, a condition holds.
Under that condition old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When the practice has been carried out for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The specific practice referred to is presupposed from preceding verses.
plain_english: When this has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
